verdict.rationale: IRCC's own site points to a sanctioned representative rail. It lists representatives as an account type alongside GCKey and employers (ircc-docs-8), and offers a way to check whether a representative is authorized and to report fraud (ircc-docs-13). Both are only navigation-level mentions, though, with no detail on how a representative is appointed or acts on an employer's behalf. Missing for 10: documentation of how a company appoints a representative or designee, the scope of what an authorized representative can do for an employer, which representatives qualify as authorized, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
